data.fund_type: An open-ended Sectoral Target Maturity Debt Index Fund investing in constituents of CRISIL-IBX AAA Financial Services Index –Dec 2026. A moderate interest rate risk and relatively low credit risk.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate returns that are commensurate (before fees and expenses) with the performance of CRISILIBX AAA Financial Services Index – Dec 2026 which seeks to track the performance of AAA issuers from the ﬁnancial services sector maturing near target date of the index. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
